title: Give-and-Go Wing Pass
description: A passer feeds the wing then cuts hard to the basket expecting the return pass — the simplest read-and-react passing pattern in the game.

content.objective: Pass and immediately cut hard to the rim, expecting the ball right back.
content.setup: A passer starts at the top of the key, a wing player stands at the left wing.
instructions: Pass to the wing player and immediately cut hard toward the basket.
The wing player catches, pivots, and times the return pass to the cutter's path.
The cutter finishes a layup off the return pass.
Rotate: the cutter becomes the next passer at the top.
coachingPoints: Cut immediately after the pass — don't watch it travel.
Cut hard and change speed to create separation.
The wing player should lead the return pass to where the cutter is going.
commonMistakes: Standing and admiring the first pass instead of cutting.
Cutting too wide instead of straight toward the rim.
Catching flat-footed instead of stepping to meet the ball.
content.safety: Keep the landing area under the rim clear between reps.
